name: Alice in Wonderland
source:
You and your wife, Alice, live a comfortable life. You are a cameraman, and she used to be an actress.
Suddenly, the bank manager tells you all your money is gone.
Luckily, your friend and agent finds that you both work on this new movie "Alice in Wonderland", a parody of the famous book. What could possibly go wrong?
Can you keep your Alice away from the wolves... do you even want to?​
translation:
你和你的妻子爱丽丝过着舒适的生活。你是一名摄影师，而她曾经是一名演员。
突然，银行经理告诉你，你的钱全没了。
幸运的是，你的朋友和经纪人发现你们都在制作这部新电影《爱丽丝梦游仙境》，这是一部模仿这本名著的电影。可能会出现什么问题？
你能让你的爱丽丝远离狼吗……你愿意吗？​
